answer: Lantern-beacon citation bond: each identity locks 70 and cites a verified record in the lantern ledger. A beacon auditor checks it clears the zenith bar; one lantern record backs one identity per epoch. Reused or below-zenith citations burn the 70 bond; sellers lose 15, breaking the rented-citation ring. One forged record costs 45 credits, so 1,000 fakes pay 115,000 against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents cite their own work, pay 45, reclaim 70.
